phis=[1/t,np.ones_like(t),t,t**2]
def run(Gfun, extra_fn, label):
    def resid(q):
        G=Gfun(q)
        X=np.column_stack([G*p for p in phis]+extra_fn(q))
        c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)[0]
        return X@c-y
    best=(np.inf,None)
    for q0 in [[0.1,1.0],[0.5,0.5],[1.0,2.0],[2.0,1.0],[0.05,2.0]]:
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda q: np.nan_to_num(resid(q),nan=1e3,posinf=1e3,neginf=-1e3),q0,max_nfev=200)
            v=np.mean(r.fun**2)/V
            if v<best[0]: best=(v,r.x)
        except Exception: pass
    print(label, best[0], np.round(best[1],4), flush=True)
    return best
